Dashboard.alt: Dashboard showing status badges, diff stats, tags, and approvals for all agents at a glance

Live Terminal Streaming.alt: A session open on its live terminal tab, showing the agent output streaming in real time

Browser Element Inspector.alt: A session open on its Browser tab, where page elements can be inspected and sent to the agent

Diff Viewer.alt: A session open on its diff tab, listing the files the agent changed with added and removed lines

Notifications.alt: The notifications page listing alerts for agents that need attention, with an unread count

Instant Search.alt: Instant search narrowing the session list from 6 agents down to 2 as the query "payment" is typed

Status Filtering.alt: Status filter showing every session with a Needs Approval gate, with other statuses hidden

Tag-Based Grouping.alt: Sessions grouped by tag, with a single session appearing under more than one tag group

Workspace Switcher.alt: The workspace switcher dropdown listing the available project workspaces

Bulk Actions.alt: Select mode on the session list with the bulk action toolbar for pausing, resuming and tagging several sessions at once

Review Queue.alt: Review Queue listing pending agent actions with diffs ready to approve or reject before they reach the codebase

Auto-Approval Rules.alt: List of 100+ built-in auto-approval rules covering read-only commands, safe git operations, and common dev tasks

Custom Rules.alt: Adding a custom approval-rule pattern like ^git log so it is never flagged for manual review again

Approval Analytics.alt: The Approval Analytics section showing how automatic rules decided past approval requests

History Search.alt: The history browser with full-text search across past agent conversations

Logs Viewer.alt: The application logs page with time range, export and density controls

Config Viewer.alt: The configuration page showing the current settings sections

Parallel Fan-Out.alt: Three variants of the same task side by side so one can be picked as the winner

Isolated Git Workspaces.alt: Each agent session running in its own isolated git worktree with no branch conflicts between sessions
